load_entries: load leaderboard entries from an entry loader and return cleaned AgentData sequences
clean_single_agent: clean and validate a single agent's evaluation data by fixing duplicates, filling missing values, and computing health metrics
combine_leaderboards: combine multiple LeaderboardData objects into a single unified leaderboard
join_metadata: join a DataFrame with GP settings based on problem_id to enrich agent evaluation data
create_leaderboard_data: create a LeaderboardData object from a sequence of AgentData instances with optional sweep variables
